# `org.get`

Show an organization

Public organizations render for anyone. Private organizations render for members and 404 otherwise.

- Method and path: `GET /orgs/{org}`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie org get`
- MCP: `org_get`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `not-found`, plus the framework problems.
